2609.15404.title: Who Teaches Which Token? Verifier-Gated Multi-Expert On-Policy Distillation for Scientific Reasoning
2609.15404.paper_summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming the standard way to integrate specialist capabilities into one model: train experts with RL, then distill them into the student on its own rollouts. Existing recipes assign supervision at the sequence level - each prompt goes to one domain teacher and every token receives the same weight - which implicitly assumes that a teacher is uniformly useful across a response. We find instead that useful teacher signal is sparse and heterogeneous along a reasoning trajectory, which raises a finer question: who should teach which token? Verifier-Gated Multi-Expert On-Policy Distillation (VG-OPD) answers it by verification: the counterfactual gain of an expert on a specific answer criterion licenses that expert to teach, its disagreement with the student localizes the supervision, and criterion importance sets its weight; the gated KL enters GRPO as an additive token-level advantage. Instantiated for scientific reasoning with RL-trained capability experts, VG-OPD attains the best overall performance on seven benchmarks for 4B and 8B students, ranking first on five at both scales, with the largest gains on knowledge-intensive scientific reasoning tasks. Further analysis shows that the gains come from localizing verified supervision rather than from adding teachers or distillation loss: misplacing the same supervision budget is the single most damaging change, and indiscriminate distillation drags RL below its own floor where gated distillation lifts it.
2609.15404.paper_summary_zh: 多教師的政策蒸餾（OPD）正逐漸成為將專家能力整合到單一模型中的標準方法：首先訓練專家，然後將其蒸餾到學生自己的回合中。現有的方法在序列層面上分配監督——每個提示都由一個領域教師處理，每個標記都獲得相同的權重——這隱含地假設教師在整個回應中均勻有用。我們發現有用的教師信號在推理軌跡上是稀疏且異質的，這引出了更細緻的問題：誰應該教哪個標記？驗證門控多專家政策蒸餾（VG-OPD）通過驗證來回答這一問題：專家在特定回答標準上的反事實增益授權該專家進行教學，與學生的分歧則定位了監督，而標準的重要性設置了其權重；門控KL作為附加的標記級優勢進入GRPO。VG-OPD針對經過RL訓練的能力專家進行科學推理的實例化，在4B和8B學生的七個基準中達到了最佳的整體表現，在兩個規模的五個基準中均排名第一，並在知識密集型科學推理任務上獲得了最大的增益。進一步的分析顯示，增益來自於定位經過驗證的監督，而不是增加教師或蒸餾損失：錯位相同的監督預算是最具破壞性的變化，而不加區別的蒸餾則使RL低於其自身的底線，而門控蒸餾則將其提升。
2609.15404.author: Xun Xu et.al.
